title: core.fulfillment.completed v1
description: Published by CORE after MOVE reports the final execution outcome.

reason.description: Closure reason when the outcome is failed. Values produced by CORE include move_execution_failed, payment_settlement_failed:*, payment_hold_not_found, payment_hold_already_captured, payment_hold_not_authorized and payment_hold_expired.

settlement_state.description: State of the CORE money hold at closure. A completed outcome is always captured or none; a failed outcome is released, none or unsettled. Optional and additive; consumers may ignore it.
